description: Analyzes protein-ligand and protein-protein interactions from PLIP XML reports and AlphaFold model packages using a self-contained standard-library XML parser: extracts residue-level salt bridges, hydrogen bonds, hydrophobic, pi-stacking, water bridges, halogen bonds and metal complexes, ranks hotspot residues, and emits Mermaid network graphs plus PyMOL annotation scripts. This skill should be used when interaction detection, hotspot ranking, PLIP report parsing, interaction network visualisation or AlphaFold confidence analysis is requested.
